title: The Silence of the Lambs
author: Thomas Harris
summary: An FBI trainee is sent to interview a brilliant imprisoned psychiatrist who is also a cannibal, in the hope that he can help catch a killer who is taking young women. Their conversations become a dangerous trade.
readIf: you want a taut, psychological thriller with one of crime fiction's most chilling characters.
skipIf: you dislike graphic crime-scene detail and disturbing violence against women.

pairings.reason: The earlier book in the same series, and a leaner pursuit of another disturbing killer.
A forensic race against a killer, with another smart investigator in an unusual position.
A newer, bleaker crime story with an intense female lead and a very dark mystery.
